posts.text: Emails for those selected in the Riftbound x K/DA Couture Collection drawing have gone out today! 🔥 Check your inbox or spam folder for an email from support@riotgames.com. Please watch out for impersonators and only trust emails from the official address above.

November 2026 events calendar — Riftbound Radiance Skirmish 1 on Sunday, Nov 22 at 12:00 PM. (One Piece OP18 Release Event the same day at 5:00 PM.) No entry fee, format, or prizing stated in the post.
